methods.steps: tesseract capture.png recognized -l eng
methods.limits: Needs Tesseract and the English language data installed; the output needs proofreading.

methods.steps: Display the PNG; Windows+Shift+T; drag over the text; paste the clipboard into a text editor and save as .txt.
methods.limits: Windows only; reads a screen region, not the file; the text may not be perfect and needs a quick proofread.

methods.steps: Open the PNG in Preview; drag to select the text; Control-click > Copy Text; paste into TextEdit; Format > Make Plain Text; save.
methods.limits: Live Text isn't available in all regions or languages.

methods.steps: Windows: select slide > File > Save As/Save a Copy > PNG > Save > Just This One or All Slides. Mac: Normal view > File > Export > File Format PNG > Save Current Slide Only (optional Width/Height) > Export.
methods.limits: Mac steps cover only the current slide; static images.

methods.steps: File > Open and select the PPT; File > Export; PNG as file type; Save; extra PNG options appear.
methods.limits: Export page does not describe the PNG options.

methods.steps: Open PPT; File > Export To > Images; choose an image format.
methods.limits: macOS only; source does not name PNG.

methods.steps: magick texture.tga preview.jpg
methods.limits: Needs an ImageMagick build with TGA and JPEG support.

methods.steps: Open the TGA; File > Export As; enter a name ending in .jpg; Export; confirm the JPEG export options.
methods.limits: JPEG export supports no transparency or layers.

methods.steps: from PIL import Image; Image.open("texture.tga").convert("RGB").save("preview.jpg")
methods.limits: Needs Python and Pillow; the Targa must be converted to RGB before saving as JPEG.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i archive.wma -vn -c:a pcm_s16le working.wav
methods.limits: 16-bit PCM output; the source must be decodable; no DRM removal.

methods.steps: Add the WMA files; select the output format; click Start.
methods.limits: The product page lists WMA and WAV among the formats it converts but doesn't label input and output.

methods.steps: Install the FFmpeg import library; open the unprotected WMA; File > Export Audio; choose WAV in Save as type; set the Encoding.
methods.limits: Protected audio is excluded.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i lesson.wmv -c:a aac -c:v libx264 review.mov
methods.limits: Desktop defaults differ from this page's settings; the installed FFmpeg must decode WMV.

methods.steps: Open the image in Edit; Output icon or File > Output; enter file name, type, compression, color space and size; Save. Several: select in Viewer; Output icon or File > Export; set file settings; Continue.
methods.limits: Camera must be supported; raw development choices affect appearance.

methods.steps: magick capture.arw delivery.jpeg; -define dng:use-camera-wb=true noted on the format page.
methods.limits: ARW listed as read-only (R), JPEG as read/write; build must support ARW.

methods.steps: magick identify suspect.bin; if a picture is recognized, magick suspect.bin recovered.png. Local test: PNG saved as .bin identified as PNG; random bytes gave no decode delegate.
methods.limits: Conditional image recognition only; arbitrary binary data is not decoded.

methods.steps: Copy with real extension; File > Open; File > Export As; edit Name field to recovered.png; Export.
methods.limits: Not a universal BIN decoder; identity and input support must be established first.

methods.steps: Open a picture copy; File > Export; Format pop-up menu > PNG; name; Save.
methods.limits: macOS readable-image export only, not firmware or arbitrary binary conversion.

methods.steps: Open the drawing; File > Export (current drawing as CAM, pdf or image); PNG among supported bitmap formats.
methods.limits: Menu reference only; does not describe PNG options.

methods.steps: dwg2bmp -o plan.png plan.dxf; converts a DXF or DWG file into a bitmap; -r pixels per drawing unit, -b background.
methods.limits: Command line tools ship with QCAD Professional.

methods.steps: File > Import the GIF; choose Embed (stores image inside the SVG); save as SVG. Optional: select the picture and Path > Trace Bitmap.
methods.limits: GIF animation unsupported on import; embedding does not create paths.

methods.steps: Select bitmap; Shape > Convert > To Polygon; adjust dialog; File > Export, choose a graphics file type.
methods.limits: Export page lists SVG among types without an options dialog; polygon conversion is a vector approximation.

methods.steps: Open the HEIC; File > Export As; WebP in file-type list or name ending .webp; Export; WebP dialog: Lossless checkbox, image/alpha quality.
methods.limits: Requires HEIF import support; desktop settings differ from the page's fixed quality.

methods.steps: magick phone.heic published.webp
methods.limits: Format page: HEIC and WEBP are RW; HEIC requires libheif delegate, WEBP requires WEBP delegate.

methods.steps: heif-dec phone.heic published.webp; format chosen from output suffix; README: JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP or Y4M.
methods.limits: WebP output requires a build with WebP support (HAVE_LIBWEBP); default WebP quality 75 in source.
